newsitem.title: FRANCE: Palestinian leader Arafat to meet France's Chirac.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian leader Arafat to meet France's Chirac.

text.p: Yasser Arafat, president of the Palestinian authority, will meet French President Jacques Chirac on Friday in Paris, the French presidency said on Thursday.
Arafat will be in Paris for a UNESCO colloquium honouring the late French president Francois Mitterrand, who died a year ago, eight months after leaving office.

Chirac has pushed hard in recent months for a bigger role for Paris in the Middle East peace process, which is currently bogged down over the timetable for a promised Israeli troop withdrawal in the West Bank.
